scope: Standalone autonomous-program validator registry identity and authority shape handling.

verification.before: Fault injection produced 20 failing subcases and five uncaught errors across 21 tests. Duplicate work/decision IDs were silently indexed with the last row winning; invalid actor and authorization types could raise exceptions.
verification.after: 22 unittest methods pass, including duplicate registries, non-list registries, invalid row types/IDs, malformed program authorization/owner and decision actors. Current shared-batch and documentation receipts remain valid.
verification.read_only: Valid and malformed fixtures preserve every file byte. No network access, mutation, approval or inferred completion is added.
verification.review: Lookup now uses validated object rows and unique non-empty string IDs. Program authority and human-owner shapes are checked before lookup; actor is checked before accessing fields. Failures identify the registry/field.
verification.current_program: 21 completed entries remain supported; item22 remains in progress pending merged tooling receipt.

limitations: Same-assistant implementation and review. Tests validate record handling, not authenticity of approval, factual truth or live publication.
Scope is registry/authority shape and duplicate handling, not an exhaustive schema validator for every field.
delivery: Pending passing required CI and exact-head merge. Website deployment not required because only repository tooling and records changed.
